## LinkedIn

**Platform:** LinkedIn  
**Caption:**

Melbourne's winter ends on paper in 11 days. What it leaves behind on your paintwork takes longer to address.

If you're driving a prestige vehicle through inner-city Melbourne or along the bay — Brighton, Sandringham, St Kilda, the Mornington Peninsula — your paint has been absorbing three types of contamination since June: iron fallout from brake dust (wet roads amplify the transfer rate significantly), salt aerosol from Port Phillip Bay, and bird acid from species that shelter in inner-suburban car parks. Standard washes don't remove embedded contamination. They redistribute it.

The cost calculus for a high-value vehicle is straightforward. A pre-spring decontamination detail runs $99–$150 and resets your surface before September UV accelerates oxidation on any compromised areas. Deferred maintenance here compounds into machine polishing or respray territory — typically $300–$2,000+ depending on depth and panel count. The window to address it cheaply is now, not when the damage is visible.

We work across Melbourne's Inner East and Bayside on a fully mobile basis — certified technicians to your home, office, or car park, no drop-off required. Our Signature Membership ($149/mo) includes bi-monthly detail and ceramic maintenance, which means the car stays on top of this proactively. If you're managing a vehicle that represents you or your brand on Melbourne's roads, this is the week to reset it before spring.
